material.locator: Eurostat, Review and implementation of the degree of urbanisation — 2026 edition, §2.1 (printed p. 7).
material.description: §2.1 identifies the three Level 1 classes as cities, towns and semi-dense areas, and rural areas. It describes Level 1 classification from 1 km² population-grid cells using population density and population-size thresholds; Level 2 further subdivides the classes into seven categories. The intermediate Level 1 class is not reduced to 'small towns' alone. Eurostat Statistical Report attribution; EU-owned text-only factual paraphrase under CC BY 4.0 with changes indicated.
